title: THE FAA HAS LIFTED THE NATIONWIDE GROUND STOP The halt was lifted at 8:15 p.m. ET after more than four hours, according to The Air Current. More than 13,000 flights were delayed or canceled, with major backlogs still affecting airports, including Chicago O’Hare and Atlanta. CBS
